Uttarakhand
State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
Food Distribution Ration Card Rice Yellow Card
The scheme "State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)" was launched by the
Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of
Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide rice at subsidized rates to yellow ration
card holders in the state.

10/2/26, 3:35 PM State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/sfyyrc 1/6
Eligibility
Application Process
Offline
Feedback Under this scheme, each ration card holder receives 7.50 kg of rice per month at the
rate of ₹11/- per kg.
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
2. The annual family income of the applicant should be ₹5 lakh or less.
To obtain this type of ration card, the applicant must first collect the
application form from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Supply
Inspector, Regional Food Officer, or District Supply Officer of the respective
area.
Along with the application, the applicant is required to submit the Aadhaar
cards of all family members, a photograph of the head of the family, a mobile
phone number, bank account details, gas connection details, voter ID card,
PAN card, income certificate, and electricity bill to the concerned office.
10/2/26, 3:35 PM State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/sfyyrc 2/6
Documents Required
In rural areas, the Gram Panchayat Development Officer records the
applicant’s name and forwards it with a recommendation to the Food Supply
Department for further action. In urban areas, the Food Supply Department
conducts an investigation, and if the application is found correct, the details
are digitized. The applicant can then contact the District Supply Office within
ten days to obtain the ration card.
If the income of a ration card holder increases, it is the responsibility of the
holder to inform the District Supply Officer. In such cases, the individual is
removed from the scheme by the department. The District Supply Officer also
conducts inspections from time to time, and action for removal is taken even
after a proposal is passed by the Gram Panchayat. Additionally, if any third
party provides information regarding ineligibility, the department investigates
the matter, and if the information is found correct, the ration card of the
concerned holder is cancelled.
1. Aadhaar cards of all family members
2. Photograph of the head of the family
3. Mobile phone number
4. Bank account details
5. Gas connection details
